definitions.explanation: A building constructed specifically for performing {能|のう} (Noh), with a distinctive stage roofed like a shrine and connected to the audience by a raised bridgeway.

examples.japanese: {能楽堂|のうがくどう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a Noh theater.
I watch Noh at a Noh theater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧{能楽堂|のうがくどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解説付|かいせつつ}き⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧もある。
examples.english: The National Noh Theater also holds performances with commentary for beginners.

notes:
A theater built specifically for ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (Noh), distinguished from an ordinary theater by its roofed stage — modeled on a shrine stage — and the {橋掛|はしがか}り, a raised bridge along which performers enter.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧{能楽堂|のうがくどう}: the National Noh Theater (in Tokyo)
- {能楽堂|のうがくどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to perform at a Noh theater

Major cities each have their own {能楽堂|のうがくどう}; unlike a general theater (⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧), the term is reserved for venues built to the traditional Noh-stage design.
